sentences.text:
Author: Suvra Ghosh
Bench: Suvra Ghosh
June 14, 2024 11 Ardr Crr 2291 of 2024 Amrit Das & ors.
Vs. The State of West Bengal & anr.
Adv. Satarup Purakayatha, Adv. Masta Fizur Rahaman, ... for the petitioners.

It is submitted on behalf of the petitioners that the 2 nd opposite party lodged a complaint against the petitioners under Sections 498A/323/307/406/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code which was registered as Kanksa Police Station Case no. 471 of 2022 dated 30th December, 2022.

entities.text: Kanksa Police Station Case no. 471 of 2022
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Subsequently, the 2nd opposite party has lodged second complaint against the petitioners on identical allegations which is subject matter of the present application.
The petitioners seek quashing of the second First Information Report being Kanksa Police Station case no. 355 of 2023 dated 28 th November, 2023.
The petitioners are directed to serve copy of the application along with annexure thereto upon the opposite parties and file affidavit of service on the adjourned date.
Let the matter appear under the heading "Contested Application" on 10th September, 2024.

The First Information Report registered as Kanksa Police Station Case no. 355 of 2023 dated 28 th November, 2023 pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Durgapur, Paschim Burdwan, be stayed till 30 th September, 2024.
